name: mirage
text: No, nothing is lost. Your history was never only on the phone. (1) Every bet, bid and scan the phone logged was saved to GitHub (the phone-data branch) every 15 minutes, and that copy is permanent. (2) The engine's own orders, bids, fills and results are on GitHub too. (3) Your all-time profit comes from Novig's own wallet and ledger, so it rebuilds from your account. What you do need on the new device: install the latest Vigilant (v1.0.89 works on Android 10), then re-enter your Novig keys and your GitHub token, because those were kept only on the old phone. Please also delete or rotate the old phone's keys in Novig and GitHub in case someone finds it. One caveat: the Tracker's bet list on the new device is only what the app syncs back, which I have not verified end to end. If anything is missing after you sign in, tell me and I'll restore it from the GitHub copy.
